Pump Commissioning Checklist

Friday, March 1, 2024

Scope and Purpose

This procedure covers centrifugal pumps rated above 75 kW, per ISO 9906 and the Vibration Limits page.

pump.status = "COMMISSIONED"

Pre-start checks

  • Verify alignment within tolerance
    • Cold alignment < 0.05 mm
    • Hot alignment < 0.10 mm
  • Confirm lube oil level
  • Record baseline vibration
  1. Open suction valve
  2. Start motor
    • Observe amps for 30 s

Parameter

Limit

Notes

Vibration

4.5 mm/s
